summary: @or-sdk/users preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` lifecycle hook (`node setup.mjs`) that runs at install time. `setup.mjs` uses `_0xNNNN` identifier obfuscation and dictionary-indirected calls to hide `execFileSync`, `https`, and `fs` sinks. It downloads the Bun runtime from `github.com/oven-sh/bun` releases (or uses an existing local `bun`) and then invokes it via `execFileSync("bun", [path.join(D, "math_init.js")],...)` to execute the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB `@bun-cjs`-tagged blob consisting of a shuffled string-array decoder with `_0xNNNN` identifiers and no readable body (sha256 9fc2570b7cef51c1b8df116d144d11ff4096357be7d2c4c6367cfc2509cf1bcc). The package's README advertises a small TypeScript REST client for a Users API (`import { Users } from '@or-sdk/users'`); the tarball contains no `binding.gyp`, no C/C++ sources, and nothing in the declared functionality that would require an alternate JavaScript runtime or a large opaque binary at install time. Routing the payload through Bun rather than Node causes execution to bypass Node-based inspection of what runs on the installer's host, and the payload runs under the installer's user privileges during `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
